# CryptoMap360

> CryptoMap360 is the #1 global crypto discovery platform connecting crypto users with KYB-verified merchants worldwide. It provides an interactive map of businesses that accept cryptocurrency payments, real-time crypto market data, exchange rankings, and a listing submission portal. Powered by VLINKPAY licensed fintech infrastructure.

CryptoMap360 is a React 18 + TypeScript single-page application built with Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, React Router v7, TanStack Query v5, and Zustand. It integrates Google Maps and Mapbox for interactive geospatial merchant discovery.

Key capabilities:
- Interactive map of KYB-verified crypto-accepting businesses in 190+ countries
- Business categories: Beauty, Restaurant, Food, Apparel, E-Gift Code, Prepaid Cards, Destination, Entertainment, Home, Lifestyle, Shopping, Wellness, Services, Retail, Transportation, Fintech
- Supported cryptocurrencies: BTC, ETH, BNB, USDT, USDV, XRP, SOL, DOGE, VMM
- GPS-based "Near Me" search and advanced filtering (by category, crypto type, KYB verification)
- Real-time cryptocurrency market data (coin rankings by market cap/volume)
- Cryptocurrency exchange rankings by trust score and volume
- "List Your Coin" submission portal for crypto projects
- Multilingual support: English and Vietnamese (VN)
- Mobile-first responsive design with smooth animations via Motion

Public REST API base URL: `https://api.cryptomap360.com`

## Pages

- [Landing Page](https://cryptomap360.com/): Hero section with 3D interactive globe, merchant highlights, feature showcase, and call-to-action for crypto discovery.
- [Map Page](https://cryptomap360.com/map): Core interactive map powered by Google Maps. Displays KYB-verified merchants as clustered markers. Supports GPS location, address search, business detail cards, directions, and advanced filters.
- [Market Page](https://cryptomap360.com/market): Cryptocurrency market data — coin rankings by market cap and volume, global market stats, and highlights (top gainers, losers, trending). Data sourced via CoinGecko with internal fallback.
- [Exchange Page](https://cryptomap360.com/exchange): Cryptocurrency exchange directory ranked by trust score and 24h trading volume. Sourced from VLINKPay direct service.
- [About Page](https://cryptomap360.com/about): Company mission, vision, and key highlights (Global Coverage, KYB Verified, Community Driven, VLINKPAY Infrastructure).
- [List Your Coin Page](https://cryptomap360.com/list-your-coin): Multi-step form for crypto projects to apply for listing on CryptoMap360. Submits to `/api/v1/public/crypto/listing-submissions`.
- [KYB Page](https://cryptomap360.com/kyb): Know Your Business verification information for merchants seeking to list their business.
- [Report Listing Page](https://cryptomap360.com/report-listing): User-facing form to report incorrect or fraudulent business listings.
- [Privacy Policy](https://cryptomap360.com/privacy): Data collection and usage policies.
- [Terms of Service](https://cryptomap360.com/terms): Platform usage terms and conditions.
- [Cookie Policy](https://cryptomap360.com/cookies): Cookie usage disclosure.

## API Endpoints

- [Merchants API](https://api.cryptomap360.com/api/v1/public/businesses): `GET /api/v1/public/businesses` — Returns a list of KYB-verified crypto-accepting businesses. Supports filtering by location, category, and crypto type.
- [Crypto Markets API](https://api.cryptomap360.com/api/v1/public/crypto/markets): `GET /api/v1/public/crypto/markets` — Returns cryptocurrency rankings with market cap, price, volume, and 24h change data.
- [Crypto Exchanges API](https://api.cryptomap360.com/api/v1/public/crypto/exchanges): `GET /api/v1/public/crypto/exchanges` — Returns exchange listings with trust score, trading volume, and metadata.
- [Listing Submission API](https://api.cryptomap360.com/api/v1/public/crypto/listing-submissions): `POST /api/v1/public/crypto/listing-submissions` — Accepts crypto project listing applications.

## Data Models

The core `Business` entity has the following shape:
- `id`: string
- `name`: string
- `address`: string
- `category`: BusinessCategory (one of 15 categories)
- `kybVerified`: boolean — whether the business passed Know Your Business checks
- `cryptoAccepted`: CryptoType[] — array of supported crypto symbols
- `location`: `{ lat, lng, city?, state?, country?, zipCode? }`
- `rating`: number (1–5 stars)
- `reviewCount`: number
- `distanceMiles?`: number — populated only in location-based (near-me) queries

## Optional

- [Frontend Architecture](https://cryptomap360.com/about): React 18 SPA using Vite 6, Tailwind CSS v4, React Router v7, TanStack Query v5 for server-state, Zustand for client-state, and Radix UI + shadcn/ui primitives.
- [VLINKPAY Infrastructure](https://cryptomap360.com/about): CryptoMap360 is backed by VLINKPAY, a licensed fintech company providing compliant payment and identity infrastructure.
